capabilities: Generate content from selected text, lines, or blocks using prompt templates
Create prompt template files with Chinese and English versions
Run multi-turn conversations marked by horizontal rules
Review past conversation details including prompts and token usage
extras: README is written in Chinese (with a Chinese-first intro); API calls cost money per Zhipu's published pricing, and image generation consumes a large number of tokens.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to call the Zhipu AI service for text generation, image generation, or knowledge-base Q&A inside notes.
